move.body:
Dear Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH team,

Your team has flagged unused machining capacity; it sounds like putting that capacity to work matters to you. We recognise the strain caused by our late payments and will ensure payment when due. How much room can you create on price in exchange for faster, dependable payment?

Kind regards,
